export_components.name: CCD/C-CDA Documents
export_components.description: Bulk export of HL7 CCDA xml files which comply to US Core Data for Interoperability (USCDI), Version 1 requirements.
export_components.notes: References standard HL7 C-CDA specifications. No product-specific mapping or customization documented.

export_components.name: FHIR Bulk Data Access
export_components.format: FHIR R4 / US Core STU V3.1.1
export_components.description: HL7 FHIR R4, FHIR US Core Implementation Guide STU V3.1.1, HL7 FHIR Bulk Data export.
export_components.notes: Explicitly references 170.315(g)(10) SmartOnFHIR API Documentation. Points to documents.maximus.care which documents standard US Core resources only.

export_components.name: Patient Demographics & Insurance
export_components.description: This file offers a comprehensive view of demographics and insurance details structured for clarity and ease of access.
export_components.notes: One-sentence description only. No column headers, field names, data types, or value sets documented.

export_components.name: Appointments
export_components.description: This file offers a comprehensive view of all future appointment details, structured for clarity and ease of access.
export_components.notes: One-sentence description only. Specifies 'future' appointments only — historical visit data apparently excluded.

export_components.name: Documents (Scanned Documents)
export_components.description: Signed progress notes, available lab results, radiology reports, and any other scanned or uploaded document in the patient's record. Sorted and indexed within patient chart number folders with category subfolders.
export_components.notes: Documents organized by patient chart number with category subfolders (Lab Reports, Radiology, Scanned Receipts, etc.). No metadata schema or manifest documented.
